text: Permission to open the free PDF of the 1782-1787 Greek Catholic parish papers for Ung county (real.mtak.hu/63713). It should say outright whether Senné was a daughter village of the Iňačovce parish (PL-H-001).

Permission to open the Slovak Wikipedia pages for Senné and Iňačovce and the FamilySearch catalogue entries 710997 and 1411329. The second would show whether Solymos is in the Uzhhorod series (PL-H-005).

From the line agents, when they have them: any house numbers, any place names written on register pages, and the archive reference on the 1869 and c. 1754 images. Each one is a test for a place hypothesis.
